reason: The cornea and lens both bend light, so combining them is a reasonable start on the focusing front.
expectation: They should form the focusing part of the eye front.

effect: The cornea and lens now focus light together; the iris is still needed to control it.
reaction: The rays bending toward one area make their shared job clear.
reason: The iris is the remaining piece shown controlling the light entering the eye.
expectation: The iris should join the focusing front and control its opening.

alternatives.reason: I could build the separate light-sensitive lining first.

effect: The eye front now both focuses light and controls how much enters; the light-sensitive lining remains to be built.
reaction: The picture makes the iris's separate job clear.
reason: The light-sensitive cells and nerve cells are the available pieces for the lining and its outgoing signal.
expectation: They should form a light-sensitive lining connected to outgoing nerve fibres.

effect: The light-sensitive cells and nerve cells formed the retina and optic nerve; the remaining goal is to join the lining to the eye front.
reaction: The picture makes it clear how the outgoing fibres gather into a bundle.
reason: The goal explicitly asks to bring the focusing front and sensing lining together.
expectation: They should form an eye with the focusing front directing light toward the retina.

effect: The completed eye shows light focused on the retina and signals traveling along the optic nerve toward the brain. All chapter goals are complete.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the two separately built parts work together.

mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the eye front and retina was most worthwhile because the cutaway brought focusing, sensing and the outgoing signal together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the iris was clear but predictable: its picture and the goal already made its placement and purpose apparent.

surprise.text: The retina result clarified that nerve fibres gather from the light-sensitive lining into the optic nerve.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt purposeless; the pictures and goals explained how the parts related.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing the independent parts come together made me curious about how another body system might work, though these combinations were fairly straightforward.
